verdict.language_detail: PML (Prague Markup Language) XML annotation layer — morphological data (m-layer) for Czech WSJ corpus
verdict.provenance_detail: Auto-generated morphological annotation layer from the Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank (PCEDT), part of PDT-C corpus at UFAL
verdict.purpose: Morphological annotation (m-layer) of Czech text from WSJ article wsj1032, containing word forms, lemmas, and morphological tags generated by an automatic tagger, stored in PML (Prague Markup Language) XML format as part of the PCEDT treebank.
